title: Star Trek: Picard Almost Starred Uhura Instead
summary:
Before Star Trek: Picard told the last voyage of Captain Jean-Luc Picard, it almost told a very different story. The first idea starred someone else: Nyota Uhura.

Picard co-creators Alex Kurtzman and Kristen Beyer shared the plan in an interview with TrekCore. They wanted to bring back Nichelle Nichols, who played Uhura, the communications officer of the first Enterprise. It would have been her first return to the role since 1991.

The idea started with a meeting. A very young Picard would be called to a hospital. Uhura would have a mission for him. It was linked to the Borg, the villains who later starred in Picard.

It is a fun what-if. Uhura broke new ground on TV, yet the first series did not use her enough. Her scenes were sometimes cut short. She is the only member of the first bridge crew who never came back after Star Trek VI. Nichols said no to a small part on Star Trek: Voyager. She died in 2022.

But the idea has puzzles. The Next Generation takes place nearly 100 years after the first series. How could they meet? Star Trek has bent time before. And the Borg were unknown when the Enterprise first met them. Could Uhura have known about them years earlier?
why_it_matters: It shows how your favorite shows could have turned out very differently, and how one character who did not get enough screen time can still inspire new stories.
